marta: Quick sync — Polaris reserved bring-up. Customer requested 3x baseline quota, wants steady 2k rps at peak. We're slotting load test Wed 09:00 PT. Who's owning autoscale rules + traffic-shift playbook? @alex @sam
alex: I can own autoscale rule config. Planning to set scale-out at 65% GPU util, cool-down 120s. Need exact traffic profile from CS.
sam: I'll coordinate with Jenna for traffic profile and runbook signoff. Also flagging renewal touchpoint — customer cares about latency SLAs, possible renewal negotiation if perf isn't stable. :warning:
jenna: Confirmed — will pull real traffic mix (chat + embeddings) and share CSV by EOD Monday. Also have customer feedback: they want per-route cost breakdown in console before cutover.
alex: Adding autoscale policy draft:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  cpu_target_pct: 65
  gpu_target_pct: 65
  scale_window_sec: 120
```
alex: We'll enable prefix caching for the chat heatmap to keep tail latency down. Might lower token cost too.
marta: Nice. Sam, can you add a short rollback checklist to the runbook? Steps 1-3 (traffic revert, scale cap, fallback model)
sam: On it — will attach to the runbook and ping when done. Also scheduling a dry-run Thursday 14:00 PT to validate RBAC + KMS keys.
jenna: Customer asks for a 2-hour observability walkthrough before dry-run. Can someone from eng-runtime join?
alex: I can join the walkthrough. :+1:
ops-bot: loadtest-scheduler confirmed for 2025-10-15T16:00:00Z (Wed 09:00 PT). Ticket #CS-1428 created.
marta: Perfect. Action items: marta -> confirm cutover window; alex -> push autoscale draft to repo; sam -> runbook + dry-run; jenna -> traffic CSV + customer enablement. If any blockers, call out here. :clipboard:
